tasks.label: Run Java
tasks.command: FILE="${file}"; CLASS=$(basename "$FILE" .java); PACKAGE=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*package[[:space:]]*\([^;]*\);.*/\1/p' "$FILE" | head -1); mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/.java_classes"; { javac -d "${workspaceFolder}/.java_classes" "$FILE" && if [ -n "$PACKAGE" ]; then java -cp "${workspaceFolder}/.java_classes" "$PACKAGE.$CLASS" < "${workspaceFolder}/input.txt"; else java -cp "${workspaceFolder}/.java_classes" "$CLASS" < "${workspaceFolder}/input.txt"; fi; } > "${workspaceFolder}/output.txt" 2>&1
